claim: The public download is an installable Eye Comfort Profiles Manifest V3 archive.
where: landing page download actions and README
sandbox: clean build:site output; assert the advertised path has a ZIP signature, passes unzip -t, and contains the expected MV3 manifest

claim: The live reading preview opens with sample settings in one click and saves nothing.
sandbox: fresh browser context at the landing page; click the sample action, assert seeded values and empty localStorage, then reset

claim: The product site uses no analytics or third-party runtime scripts.
where: landing footer, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh browser context; record every request while using the sample preview and assert the site origin is the only origin

claim: Every reading control works without a supporter license.
where: landing supporter section, extension popup, terms, and README
sandbox: fresh unpacked extension profile with no license; use keyboard controls, assign a profile, and assert the page presentation changes

claim: Profiles offer four font styles: system sans, rounded sans, serif, and monospaced text.
where: landing page free controls section and README
sandbox: fresh unpacked extension and local article; inspect the four named local choices, then assign the profile and assert that its selected font style reaches the article

claim: Profiles stay in browser storage and do not send page content or browsing activity to an external service.
where: landing facts, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh unpacked extension profile and local article; assert the saved profile is in extension storage, then record HTTP(S) requests through the full flow and reject every non-local origin

claim: Installed reading profiles keep working while the browser is offline.
where: landing facts, offline notice, and README
sandbox: fresh unpacked extension profile; assign a profile, take Chromium offline, change text size by keyboard, and assert the article updates

claim: A saved profile returns for its website address on the next visit.
where: landing first screen, how-it-works section, and README
sandbox: fresh unpacked extension profile and local website address; save settings, reload the article, and assert the saved presentation is reapplied

where: landing page how-it-works section and terms
sandbox: fresh unpacked extension; open chrome://settings and assert neither the injected reading style nor focus band exists

claim: The optional focus band follows a pointer or keyboard focus without capturing clicks.
where: landing page free controls section and extension popup
sandbox: fresh unpacked extension and local article; enable the band, move the pointer, focus a button, and click that button through the band

claim: A regular website stays unchanged until a reader saves a profile for its website address.
sandbox: fresh unpacked extension and local article with its own typography; assert no extension style or focus band exists before assignment

claim: Profiles and site assignments export to and restore from a portable JSON backup.
where: landing features, extension popup, privacy page, and README
sandbox: sample named profile and website-address assignment; export JSON, import it, and assert exact normalized state equality

claim: The optional decorative supporter unlock is $19 once, with no subscription; reading controls remain free.
where: landing supporter section, extension popup, terms, and README
sandbox: live product check; request the advertised checkout endpoint, assert its Dodo redirect, then inspect the hosted checkout summary for Eye Comfort Profiles at $19.00

claim: Profiles, website matching, reading controls, and backups work without a supporter license.
where: landing supporter section, extension popup, and README
sandbox: fresh unpacked extension with no license; save a keyboard-tuned profile to a local website, confirm the reading result, then export and import that profile backup

claim: Eye Comfort Profiles changes presentation only and does not test, diagnose, prevent, or treat eye conditions.
where: landing page medical boundary and terms
sandbox: fresh landing-page browser context; assert the visible medical-boundary heading and exact scope statement

claim: A valid returned supporter license unlocks exactly three decorative faceplates.
where: landing supporter section and extension popup
sandbox: fresh unpacked extension; intercept the Sociobot verification response for a returned token, then assert the token handoff and brass, coral, and petrol faceplates

claim: A stored supporter license is verified at most once per day.
sandbox: memory-backed browser storage and recorded valid verification response; advance the clock just under and then at one day

claim: A refunded supporter license no longer unlocks faceplates.
sandbox: memory-backed browser storage and recorded Sociobot revoked-license response; assert the cached verdict is inactive

claim: A supporter can restore a valid faceplate license by pasting its token on another device.
sandbox: fresh unpacked extension; paste a fixture token, intercept its valid Sociobot verification response, and assert that the three faceplates appear
